name: grab-cookie
description: Capture, store, wire, and verify a browser-session credential for sites that issue no API key and no OAuth: httpOnly session cookies, opaque localStorage bearer tokens, and custom auth headers. One DevTools Copy as cURL paste is the only human step; extraction, storage in the Windows Credential Manager or macOS Keychain, config regeneration, live verification, and expiry warning are automated. Complements connect-tool, which deliberately refuses cookie import. Markdown plus stdlib Python, no compiled binary and no MCP server.
